properties.verseOrder: v1 v2 v3 v4 v5 v6 v7

verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
ABANTU abaabeeranga
Mu nzikiza y'ensi
Omusana gubaakidde
Okugoba-okufa.

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
Watutikkula-emigugu
N'omenya-omujoozi,
Nga bwe wakola-omulabe,
Ku lwa Midiyaani.

verse.name: v4
v5
verse.lines:
Omwana atuzaaliddwa
-Omwana-atuweereddwa;
-Obuyinza bwe bulifuga,
Mu ggulu ne mu nsi.

verse.name: v6
verse.lines:
Buyinza bwe bulibuna
Mu mawanga gonna;
N'ensala ze ez'ensonga,
Za mirembe gyonna.

verse.name: v7
verse.lines:
Kale Yesu,jjangu leero
Wamu ne Kitaffe;
N'Omwoyo Omutukuvu
Tufugire ddala
